name: pnpm-turbo-monorepo-template-setup-local
description: Runs the shared setup-guard strip, then the shared workspace-initializer, and finally deletes the local setup/ folder.

tasks.name: Remove setup script (handled locally)
tasks.description: Disabled: the shared task targets the old inline unpkg command and can no longer match. scripts.setup is removed JSON-side by the shared setup-guard config. The config below is a never-matching no-op, present only because the schema requires it.

tasks.name: Remove pre-commit setup guard
tasks.description: Remove the one-time setup guard from Husky after workspace initialization completes

config.pattern:
# Block commits until the one-time workspace initializer has been run\.
node setup/guard\.mjs block \|\| exit 1

tasks.name: Delete setup folder
tasks.description: Remove the guard and this config now that setup-guard has stripped every reference to them
